about: National Fittings Limited manufactures SG/ductile-iron grooved pipe fittings, stainless-steel fittings and valves for industrial and infrastructure piping. The export-led company operates finishing and foundry units in Tamil Nadu and is pursuing a Gujarat expansion and proposed Banil Castings/Avisa merger for integrated casting-to-finished-product operations.
